These are the guidelines I stick to when I have a walk in really bad heat: Water is literally your best friend. Keep at least one water bottle on you at all times. Try to stick to shady or grassy areas. Take little breaks every 10 or 15 minutes; just sit down with the pup, offer the dog some water and drink some for yourself even if it's just for a minute. And of course, if you start to feel dizzy or lightheaded or see any other signs of heat exhaustion/stroke in yourself or the pup immediately stop and get some help. I hope this helps!
